kicker: 作業稿・コンピュータ支援の定理
title: Minimum Widths for Unit Squares in Thin Rectangles
薄い長方形に入る単位正方形の最小幅
lead: How wide must a rectangle below height two be to hold N rotated unit squares? For heights 1.851 ≤ a < 2, we give the minimum width for odd N ≥ 11 and even N ≥ 12, with explanatory figures and full English and Japanese text. Working draft; the portable computational supplement remains incomplete.
高さ2未満の長方形に、自由な向きの単位正方形をN個入れるには、どれだけの幅が必要か。高さ1.851以上2未満、奇数N≥11・偶数N≥12の最小幅を、図と日英全文で説明します。作業稿であり、可搬な計算付録は未完成です。
author: Working draft prepared for Hiroaki Hosono; authorship pending

versions.en: First working manuscript, including editorial clarifications and an interactive illustration. Mathematical content unchanged; no new certificate replay.

versions.en: Analytic proof of the even-case critical-angle minimisation: strict convexity, a uniform angle bound and a sextic equation. Geometric reduction, calibration and attainment dependencies are retained; no new certificate replay.
versions.ja: 偶数の場合の停留角の最小化を、狭義凸性・一様な角度上界・6次方程式によって解析的に証明。配置型への還元・較正・達成の依存条件は保持し、新しい証明書再生は行っていません。
